Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>why only one pander ?
>is WW toning down the weenie potential ?

Truthfully, I'm beginning to get a little concerned about vampire distribution
among clans as well.

I was initially okay with just 4 Lasombra since they got an extra vampire (and
Advanced to boot) in CE. But now, we currently have 5 !Brujah, 6 !Gangrel, 4
Lasombra, 4 !Malkavians, 6 !Nosferatu, and 1 Pander. The !Gangrel amount is
understandable, since they've always been split due to Country/City
differences.

I'm a little wary of how many !Nos are showing up, since in addition the !Nos
starter contains 2 new vampires not from the boosters. So either there's going
to be a lot of !Nos, or maybe some non-!Nos (maybe Pander) will show up in the
starter?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
> >why only one pander ?
> >is WW toning down the weenie potential ?

Wouldn't be a bad thing, either, but then it would have had to start with
the Caitiffs (well, in a way it did...).

But consider : the Caitiffs were Group 1 and became Group 3, so are
uncompatible. The Pander were Group 2, the new ones will be Group 3, so
compatible. It makes sense not to produce too many of them. Let's just hope
the old ones will be reprinted in the appropriate starters, as was Mitchell.

Orpheus

Roger, Ingram, and Tock are precon only, so should not have appeared on the
preview list as U2. A few others were omitted from their place in the list.

I've no idea if WW is doing this to keep the set consistent with the RPG
metagame, but I'd guess they are, based on the numbers. The Hand is mostly
!Assamite, which we don't get in Jyhad (though I've always thought it would
be very neat to see some !Assamites without the Blood Curse - it's not like
most of the existing Assamites are costed appropriately for their discipline
spreads, given their inherent clan flaw). Next up, numberwise, is the City
Gangrel. There are lots of !Nosferatu as well, as the Hand is about
assassination rather than outright brutality, for the most part. Panders
generally don't have the clout to get recognition within their own packs,
let alone by the Hand.

Kushiel

Messages.Author: The Fanboy
Messages.Body:
> yeah and there are so many !Tremere and Ravnos left in the WoD...

Actually, non-ethnic Ravnos are pretty populous, and are growing in
number post-week. The Week served primarily to rid the clan of the
ethnic stereotype.

As for !Tremere, they're supported because they were supported in the
past, and thus need to stay fairly balanced with the other clans.

Adding the !Assamites as a new clan is HIGHLY unlikely. More likely,
there will be Assamites with the Sabbat tag, a la Anka in Final
Nights.
